mae_mw.definition: mean absolute prediction error across aligned validation points

rmse_mw.definition: square root of mean squared error across aligned validation points

ramp_mae_mw.definition: MAE of within-day adjacent differences, 47 per target day

mean_daily_peak_absolute_error_mw.definition: mean absolute difference of predicted and actual daily maxima

mean_peak_timing_absolute_error_slots.definition: mean absolute peak-index difference; earliest maximum wins ties

daily_mae_p95_mw.definition: 95th percentile of daily MAE, linear interpolation

daily_rmse_p95_mw.definition: 95th percentile of daily RMSE, linear interpolation

bundle_predict_latency.definition: warm batch-one bundle.predict including preprocessing, inverse scaling and contract validation; excludes queue/network/load

prepared_engine_latency.definition: warm model forward on prepared tensors, excludes preprocessing and output contract validation

cold_load.definition: verified bundle loading in a fresh interpreter after imports; local OS file cache may remain warm

cold_import.definition: torch and model package import/setup time in child interpreter

cold_first_predict.definition: first bundle.predict in a fresh model instance

cold_process_wall.definition: parent wall clock around subprocess startup, imports, load, prediction and exit

latency_distribution.definition: raw calls with p50/p95/p99 using linear interpolation; warmups excluded; repeat summaries retained

sequential_capacity_forecasts_per_second.definition: 1000/mean latency_ms; sequential local capacity, not concurrent HTTP throughput

rss_bytes.definition: current process RSS where observable; null otherwise

process_lifetime_peak_rss_bytes.definition: process high-water RSS; parent includes training and dataset, child is separate fresh process

bundle_bytes.definition: sum of deployed manifest, metadata/model and weight files, excluding training checkpoint

fit_seconds.definition: existing trainer reported fit path or separately measured ridge fit; not comparable across different measurement scopes

reference_demo_max_abs_drift_mw.definition: max deviation from original committed demonstration, diagnostic for regenerated weights

reference_rmse_difference_mw.definition: new validation RMSE minus original pilot RMSE; not an optimisation effect

not_applicable_in_I0.kv_cache_bytes: Reference numerical decoder has no incremental KV cache
not_applicable_in_I0.model_superiority_p_value: Regeneration is not a new model-selection study
